name: CDF-based Ray Resampling
definition: Resamples a set of rays based on the Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) of volumetric rendering weights. It differs from standard implementations by sampling midpoints instead of start/end points and by adding a background interval to the CDF to allow samples to be assigned to the background when foreground density is low.
summary: CDF-based Ray Resampling redistributes ray samples using the cumulative distribution function, sampling interval midpoints and including a background interval to preserve energy while adapting density to signal.
